# Spinner

The spinner is the default element for loading patterns.
See [Loading guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/spinner/design)

<Canvas of={SpinnerStories.Basic} />

```css
.gap-1 {
  gap: 1rem;
}
.w-208 {
  width: 208px;
}
```

## Examples

### Progress Circle

<Canvas of={SpinnerStories.ProgressCircle} />

To set the percentage value, the component is using a local [css custom property](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Using_CSS_custom_properties) (or css variable).
See below how to set it in pure HTML.

```html
<div style="--percentage: 70" class="ds-progresscircle"></div>
```

### Dots

Use the dot loading version for targeted and/or simultaneous loading, in a chat for example.

<Canvas of={SpinnerStories.Dots} />

### Dark mode

<Canvas of={SpinnerStories.Dark} />

```css
.bg-dark {
  background-color: #111111;
}
.p-2 {
  padding: 2rem;
}
```
